thread:
Ravi: Quick brainstorm: instead of expanding slab tiers, let's pilot per-route QoS + a tiny metered "elevation" feature. Customers get a default quota per route and can call an Elevation API for short boosts billed at a premium. Keeps pricing surface small. Thoughts?

Nora: Love that. Per-route defaults are easy to reason about for developers. Two immediate asks: 1) how do we map existing commits to per-route quotas; 2) how are elevations rate-limited to prevent abuse?

Gabe: Runtime notes: tagging by route is already supported. We need three pieces: config schema for per-route quotas, an elevation token ledger, and scheduler hooks to prioritize elevated requests. Also add a safety kill-switch for global elevations.

Mei: Sales/CS: pilots will want simple migration. Proposal: convert existing commits into an equivalent per-route reserve + 30% free elevation credit for 60 days. That gives teams breathing room to validate.

legal-bot: Flag: elevation pricing must be explicit in contracts. Pilot addendum should cap credits and define conversion mechanics. Also define SLA impact if we deny an elevation during incidents.

finance-bot: Preliminary pricing: base per-token rate unchanged. Elevations = base * 2.2. Reserved per-route commit discounts still apply. I'll model revenue impact for two pilot sizes.

Ravi: UX notes: Console needs route -> default quota mapping, telemetry for elevation usage, and an SDK helper to request elevation and poll status. Also surface a clear error code when elevation denied.

Gabe: Engineering estimate: core runtime + ledger + API ~ 2.5 sprints (2 engs). Console + SDK + docs + pilot ops ~ 1.5 sprints. Total ~4 sprints. Ops asked for a rollback plan: disable elevation endpoints + convert in-flight elevations to best-effort.

Mei: Pilot candidates: will reach out to Solace and Kestrel. Offer 60-day pilot: per-route reserve conversion + 30% elevation credit, discounted reserved rate for conversion.

legal-bot: I'll prepare a short pilot addendum template (reserved routes, elevation terms, credit caps).

finance-bot: I'll share pricing sensitivity and conversion thresholds. Need to agree on how credits are refunded/accounted.

ops-bot: NOTE: short telemetry window 04:00-04:30 UTC may delay elevation metric ingestion.

Ravi: Great. I'll write RFC with schema examples and launch criteria: (1) runtime + ledger, (2) Console mapping + telemetry, (3) pilot addendum + 2 pilots, (4) billing + invoice flows tested. Tagging folks for review.

Nora: I'll add migration mapping heuristics for commits -> per-route reserves.

Gabe: Adding perf test plan for elevations.

Mei: Setting up pilot kickoff docs.

Ravi: Thanks all, circulating RFC tomorrow.
